verdict.rationale: Retell lets you test agents without going live. The dashboard "Test" button starts a free web call that needs no phone number (retell-docs-20). Conductor can also run simulation tests against an agent without real phone calls (retell-docs-55), and agents have versions with a separate publish step (retell-docs-47). This lets users check changes before deploying, but it is testing inside the same account, not a documented isolated sandbox. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode API keys, documented isolation of test data from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
